summary: The turn-2 draft lands CODEX-D295-SF1 exactly and correctly: the class recital now states normalized equality over the 42 enumerated refresh sites and byte-equality of the seven dispositions and p1p2g3Mapping, which I re-measured independently and confirmed. Every Stage A digest, verdict, grade ruling and advisory identifier in the draft matches the files. All twelve cross-lineage citations are the current versions with the correct recording D-numbers. The authority boundaries hold: no row is SATISFIED, no Class A is opened, D-137's reservation is not lifted, no register label is flattened, file 08 is untouched. One defect stands. The draft asserts `HEAD is f345657…`, but live HEAD is `81bf4bd…` — the D-294 hygiene commit that landed after D-294's adoption. The draft collapses the adoption commit and live HEAD into one value, which is the opposite of what the immediately preceding cycle's own draft did one heading earlier. Nothing operative turns on it, because the intervening commit touches no path under docs/coop or docs/v2, so it is SHOULD-FIX and not MUST-FIX; but it is a false live-state recital headed for permanent COORD prose, and the Subject paragraph anchors the whole twelve-join currency claim to the phrase 'current at HEAD'.

precedent.reading: One heading earlier, in the cycle that adopted D-294, the same two lines carried two DIFFERENT commits: the prior decision's adoption commit, and live HEAD — which was `8bc9963`, the D-293 hygiene commit that had landed after D-293's adoption and touched only DECISIONS-NEEDED.md and STATUS.2026-08-26.md. The convention is therefore settled and recent: the HEAD line names live HEAD including an intervening hygiene commit, not the prior adoption commit. D-295's situation is the identical shape — D-294 adopted at `f345657`, then hygiene at `81bf4bd` — and the turn-2 draft resolves it the opposite way. The same draft's turn-1 predecessor at `coordinator-decisions.D-294.draft.md` lines 40-42 carries the identical two-commit form, so this is not a turn-3-only refinement.
precedent.alsoConsistent: The adopted D-293 entry at COORD L161-162 pins 'Recorded from HEAD `4abb961aad98525ca8b992a24609a6286964a451` (last prior heading D-292)', and `4abb961` is in fact the parent of D-293's adoption commit `c10319d`. Recorded HEAD tracks the actual parent state, not a chosen heading.

shouldFix.whyItMatters: Two reasons, neither cosmetic. First, this line becomes permanent COORD prose asserting a repository state that did not exist at recording: were the entry adopted now, its own adoption commit's parent would be `81bf4bd`, not `f345657`. Second, the Subject paragraph at line 61 anchors the entire twelve-join currency claim to the words 'at the versions current at HEAD', and line 63 rests the D-294 custody reading on that same anchor. If the entry's HEAD token names a commit that is not HEAD, the currency claim is anchored to the wrong state — and the currency claim is the substantive content of this recording.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: Nothing operative changes between `f345657` and `81bf4bd`. I measured the intervening commit: `git show --stat --name-only 81bf4bd` touches DECISIONS-NEEDED.md, HANDOFF.D-000-orchestrator-live.txt and tools/orchestrator/** only, and no path under docs/coop or docs/v2. Live COORD is still `31746810f9be78f697d66eb94d9cd50a95a51218998f97a154596363039fb9b6` and file 08 is still `e503b75b5599444ee4d77c0c7d7c82a74026b2c1848ad214e0ac738c0aa40c3e`, both matching the prompt; the last live heading is still D-294; required-now is still 28; and all twelve cited joins remain the current versions at `81bf4bd`. The measurement survives intact — only the recital is wrong. This is the same shape and the same grade as CODEX-D295-SF1: a false source recital with no operative dependency, unsuitable for permanent COORD prose.
shouldFix.fix: Split the two commits as the D-294 drafts do. Replace line 39 with 'HEAD is `81bf4bd9909c49b8ce521e3953ec5afea0bd378f`.', keeping lines 37-38 ('D-294 is ADOPTED at `f3456575071928022a1f0e3a77e531a87157b365`.') unchanged. No other line needs to move: 'Last live heading is D-294' and 'Required-now is 28' are both true at `81bf4bd`, and the twelve citations at line 61 are current at `81bf4bd`, so the 'current at HEAD' anchor becomes correct rather than merely harmless once HEAD names the right commit.
shouldFix.notAFixBecauseItWouldBreakSomethingElse: Do not instead repoint the frozen successor. preview-product-boundary-successor.v10.json's own `head` field is `f3456575071928022a1f0e3a77e531a87157b365`, which is correct and must not change: that is the artifact's generation HEAD, it is frozen at 0444, both Stage A reviews are bound to its digest `8f34c92e…`, and editing it would move the Stage A subject and void the dual ACCEPT. The entry's live-state HEAD and the frozen artifact's generation HEAD are different facts and are allowed to differ; only the entry's line 39 is wrong.
